subject.title: fix(mattermost): key private channels as group on outbound routing

question: Should maintainers require inspectable session-store or log proof after the cache-fallback fix before landing this Mattermost namespace change?
rationale: The code direction is strong, but the live proof artifact does not show the stored namespace state and the PR changes compatibility-sensitive session routing.

options.title: Require fix plus inspectable proof
options.body: Keep this PR open until the cache fallback is fixed and the author posts redacted logs, terminal output, or an artifact showing no phantom `channel:<id>` session after a private-channel cron delivery.

options.title: Accept with explicit waiver
options.body: A maintainer can waive the proof gap and accept the remaining compatibility risk, but this should be an explicit landing decision.

options.title: Pause for canonical path selection
options.body: If maintainers prefer another implementation, keep one canonical fix path for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/95646 and close or pause the weaker sibling PRs later.

recommendation.title: Require fix plus inspectable proof
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open until the cache fallback is fixed and the author posts redacted logs, terminal output, or an artifact showing no phantom `channel:<id>` session after a private-channel cron delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history link for proof sufficiency and the private-channel `P -> group` behavior is the earlier landed Mattermost mapping commit.
